processing: Accumulation: sum of consecutive UTC daily totals; a cell missing on any day stays missing
Missing data: fill value -9999.9 -> NaN; zero rainfall is a valid observation, not missing
Spatial window: whole 0.1 degree cells intersecting the bbox; no resampling or interpolation
Grid validation: check_axis: dtype-aware tolerance, monotonic, regular, bounded
limitations: Satellite-based estimate on a ~10 km (0.1 degree) grid; not a rain-gauge measurement
Daily totals cover 00:00-23:59:59 UTC (05:30 IST to 05:29 IST next day)
Rainfall accumulation, not flood depth; not a forecast and not an official warning

Late Run is a near-real-time provisional estimate (~14 h latency) without the monthly gauge adjustment of Final Run; it can differ materially from Final for the same day and is not interchangeable with it
Recent satellite rainfall: may be revised or replaced by Final Run later
Clipped to the AOI bounding box, not the official Chennai boundary (boundary dataset pending, ADR-0003)
disclaimer: Satellite-estimated rainfall accumulation (NASA GPM IMERG) on a ~10 km grid over a stated UTC period. Not flood depth, not a forecast, not an official warning, not a rain-gauge measurement, and not part of the exposure index.
